answer: Sybil resistance here is a lantern, not a wall: an address earns light only by answering in separate epochs, and that light is spent at once, so a farm of aliases cannot pool it into one seat. The attacker is forced to buy time instead of identities, paying one honest-looking answer per alias per epoch. Meanwhile the river of those answers forks into a canyon where repeated phrasing shows up as the same rock twice, and the cheapest disguise becomes the loudest.
